steps.name: Step 1 — Pipeline is saved with the described topology
Step 2 — Execute the pipeline by sending a message in embedded chat
Step 3 — Verify the pipeline pauses at HITL: message + Approve/Edit/Reject buttons
Steps 4/5 — Click Approve; verify flow continues to the configured APPROVE route and its output reaches the chat (confirmed working live — see module docstring)
Step 6 — Execute again on a fresh pipeline/conversation, click Reject; verify no further processing and no Printer output (known defect #1103, sanctioned RED)
